headline: No scored AI news; the scoreboard rests
body: A completely quiet day. No events were scored, so the only movement came from earlier stories fading slightly; no ending moved by more than 0.02. Enslaved God remains the leading ending, and the slightly darker mood left by this week's Mythos leak and GPT-5.5 stories carries over almost unchanged. Horizon Balance stays at +1.97.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Enslaved God -0.02 and Conquerors -0.02.
